'''Michele Guindani''' is an Italian statistician, specializing in [[Bayesian inference|Bayesian]] nonparametrics and [[Biostatistics]]. He is a professor of Biostatistics at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]]<ref>{{cite web |title=UCLA Biostatistics Faculty Directory|url=https://ph.ucla.edu/about/faculty-staff-directory/michele-guindani|access-date=12 August 2026}}</ref>. He was president of the [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]] in 2025.<ref>{{cite web |title=Past Officers, Board Members, and Appointments |url=https://bayesian.org/governance/leadership/past-officers/ |access-date=8 July 2026}}</ref> He was the editor-in-chief on the academic journal ''[[Bayesian Analysis (journal)|Bayesian Analysis]]'' from 2019 to 2021,<ref>{{cite web |title=Bayesian Analysis Former Editors |url=https://www.e-publications.org/ims/submission/BA/help/formerEditors/ |access-date=8 July 2026}}</ref> and became editor-in-chief of ''[[Computational Statistics & Data Analysis]]'' in 2026.<ref>{{cite web |title=The Journal of Computational Statistics and Data Analysis welcomes two new Co-Editors-in-Chief |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/computational-statistics-and-data-analysis/about/announcements/the-journal-of-computational-statistics-and-data-analysis-welcomes-two-new-co-editors-in-chief |access-date=8 July 2026}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 2019: Fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]]<ref>{{cite web |title=2019 ASA Fellows Announcement |url=https://www.amstat.org/asa/files/pdfs/2019-ASAFellowAnnouncement.pdf|access-date=8 July 2026}}</ref>
* 2022: Fellow of the [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]]<ref>{{cite web |title=ISBA Fellows|url=https://bayesian.org/membership/isba-fellows/ |access-date=8 July 2026}}</ref>
